parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The ID of the application. You can specify only one application ID.

parameters.name: ChannelId
parameters.description: The ID of the channel. You can specify only one channel ID.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

*   **asc**: ascending order.
*   **desc**: descending order. This is the default value.

parameters.name: PageNum
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-channel-participants --app-id aec0000 --channel-id testId --page-num 1 --page-size 10 --order asc --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DescribeChannelParticipants --region cn-hangzhou --Order asc --AppId aec0000 --PageNum 1 --PageSize 10 --ChannelId testId
